release_notes:
- Smart Classificator sorts studies by design much more reliably: randomised trials, cohorts, case reports, narrative reviews and reviews that do not say so in their title are now recognised. Records it is unsure about are flagged, so "Show only low-confidence" shows exactly what to check by hand.
- New "Enrich from PubMed" button in Smart Classificator: it fetches the publication types and MeSH terms PubMed assigns to each record (by PMID or DOI), the most reliable sign of a study's design. Files imported from PubMed (.nbib) bring them automatically.
- RoB 2 and PEDro decide more often, and more accurately, whether a study is a randomised trial without using AI.
- Manuscript Reviewer recognises the study design of your manuscript more accurately.
- PRISMA: in Library you can now tell each library where its records came from (database, register, or not a search) and the name to show in the diagram, with "PRISMA source…".
- FFT Advanced searches for PDFs in the background: Nexus SR no longer freezes on a slow source, Cancel really stops the search, and the window shows what it is doing.
- Download buttons show a spinner while the file is being prepared, and tell you if something went wrong.
- Integrity checker: the list marks the studies that already have a saved report, you can save the report as Word, and the AI answers faster and costs fewer operations.
- AI tasks such as the Integrity checker, Manuscript Reviewer and risk-of-bias pre-fill answer faster and no longer return cut-off results.
- Power analysis with AI handles articles with many effect sizes: it keeps the 15 most relevant and tells you how many more there were.
- Claim-to-Citation shows how strong each match is (Strong / Partial / Weak) instead of a misleading percentage, can be limited to the studies you included, exports to CSV and also reads the tables of your .docx.
- OSF: refreshing and deleting no longer block the app, Quick Export can include your saved forest plots, and the pre-registration draft fills in the data items from your project.
- Citation Chaser can export the citation links as CSV (for Gephi or VOSviewer).
- Nexus SR now needs R 4.3 or newer, and always uses the newest R installed on your computer. If your R is too old, it tells you which version to install.
